summary.content:
Today's selection covers 59 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 35 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Is on Its Way to Upending Cybersecurity
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Germany Doxes “UNKN,” Head of RU Ransomware Gangs REvil, GandCrab
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 25 articles published in the last 24 hours
